matrix_definition: One 10x513 FC weight+bias matrix; each of five Conv matrices is Cout by flattened Cin*Kh*Kw
projection: Frobenius inner product onto span of the single forget update matrix
baselines: Orthogonal residual Frobenius norm divided by forget norm
conv_reason_for_recomputation: Previous archive retained Conv channel summaries, not full matrices
interpretation: Parameter-update anisotropy candidate, not an identity for input-patch sensitivity or guaranteed Non-IID removal
